chapter_title_en: The Celestial Palace of the Nest-Builder
chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Enters Central Plains Meets Shen Xibao
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen leaves the Pure Land and enters the Central Plains, where news of the Heavenly Palace of Youchao draws legendary figures and a decayed Taoist named Shen Xibao.
og_description: After three years in the Pure Land, Xiao Chen ventures into the Central Plains and encounters the cursed descendant of Shen Gongbao.
twitter_description: A new arc begins as Xiao Chen follows a decayed Taoist with a legendary name to the Heavenly Palace of Youchao.
